results.name: setup: black 100×30 bar on a paint layer
Ctrl+T, drag the bottom-right corner: proportional ×1.5 scale about the opposite corner
rotate 90° (Shift snaps to 15°) turns the bar vertical around its centre
Ctrl+drag a corner distorts only that corner
Edit › Warp: dragging a top-edge control point bulges the bar; Escape cancels nothing committed
Content-Aware Fill (Shift+Backspace) removes a red blob from striped texture
Patch tool: draw around a blob, drag it onto clean texture, blob is healed away
Quick Selection: painting over the bar selects it and stops at its edge; Filter Gallery filter applies
